I've been selected among the student honorees for the **seventh edition of Cuartiles Mayores** at **Escuela Superior Politécnica del Litoral (ESPOL)**.

The ceremony is scheduled for **16 November 2026 at 10:00**, at the **STEM building, Campus Gustavo Galindo Velasco**, Ecuador.
